Merge separate dada2 files
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)

# file paths
pr_file  <- "C:/Users/jacqu/Desktop/Research/Projects/BIOSSCOPE/Particle_Experiments/Joined_Files/16S/PR_ASV_nocyano_mergeready.csv"
pr2_file <- "C:/Users/jacqu/Desktop/Research/Projects/BIOSSCOPE/Particle_Experiments/Joined_Files/16S/PR2_ASV_nocyano_mergeready.csv"
pr3_file <- "C:/Users/jacqu/Desktop/Research/Projects/BIOSSCOPE/Particle_Experiments/Joined_Files/16S/PR3_ASVabund_NoCyano_mergeready.csv"

# function to read and standardize ASV column name
read_asv_table <- function(file) {
  df <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # rename first column to ASV if needed
  names(df)[1] <- "ASV"
  
  # make sure duplicate ASVs within a file are summed
  df <- df %>%
    group_by(ASV) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
  
  return(df)
}

# read files
pr  <- read_asv_table(pr_file)
pr2 <- read_asv_table(pr2_file)
pr3 <- read_asv_table(pr3_file)

# merge all by ASV
merged_asv <- list(pr, pr2, pr3) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(across(-ASV, ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))


# inspect
dim(merged_asv)
head(merged_asv[, 1:10])

# save merged table
write_csv(merged_asv, "C:/Users/jacqu/Desktop/Research/Projects/BIOSSCOPE/Particle_Experiments/Joined_Files/16S/merged_PR_PR2_PR3_ASV_table.csv")
```


Merge taxa files
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

pr_tax  <- read_csv("C:/Users/jacqu/Desktop/Research/Projects/BIOSSCOPE/Particle_Experiments/Joined_Files/16S/PR_taxa_rar11000_NoSingle_nocyano_mergeready.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
pr2_tax <- read_csv("C:/Users/jacqu/Desktop/Research/Projects/BIOSSCOPE/Particle_Experiments/Joined_Files/16S/PR2_taxa_nocyano_mergeready.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
pr3_tax <- read_csv("C:/Users/jacqu/Desktop/Research/Projects/BIOSSCOPE/Particle_Experiments/Joined_Files/16S/PR3_taxa_rar_NoCyano_mergeready.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

names(pr_tax)[1]  <- "ASV"
names(pr2_tax)[1] <- "ASV"
names(pr3_tax)[1] <- "ASV"

merged_taxa <- bind_rows(pr_tax, pr2_tax, pr3_tax) %>%
  distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)

write_csv(merged_taxa, "C:/Users/jacqu/Desktop/Research/Projects/BIOSSCOPE/Particle_Experiments/Joined_Files/16S/merged_PR_PR2_PR3_taxa.csv")
```

Merge taxa and ASV files
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# read merged files
merged_asv  <- read_csv("C:/Users/jacqu/Desktop/Research/Projects/BIOSSCOPE/Particle_Experiments/Joined_Files/16S/merged_PR_PR2_PR3_ASV_table.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
merged_taxa <- read_csv("C:/Users/jacqu/Desktop/Research/Projects/BIOSSCOPE/Particle_Experiments/Joined_Files/16S/merged_PR_PR2_PR3_taxa.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# make sure first column is named ASV in both files
names(merged_asv)[1]  <- "ASV"
names(merged_taxa)[1] <- "ASV"

# merge by ASV, keeping all ASVs from the abundance table
asv_tax_merged <- merged_asv %>%
  left_join(merged_taxa, by = "ASV")

# save
write_csv(asv_tax_merged, "C:/Users/jacqu/Desktop/Research/Projects/BIOSSCOPE/Particle_Experiments/Joined_Files/16S/merged_PR_PR2_PR3_ASV_taxa.csv")
```
